name: KyDrive
description: Private drive for files, sharing, versions and WebDAV, part of the Ky Suite.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the encrypted files and the keys: encryption.key, identity.key and the session secret and SCIM token in .icestore/ (made on first start). Back up the whole folder; without the keys the files can't be read.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Sealed backup capsules of the database and keys that KyDrive makes every day.

paths.name: Bulk
paths.description: The file backup repository (Restic) that the capsules point to. Set up by itself on first start. For real protection, copy it to another disk or machine.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyDrive web app, WebDAV (/dav) and MCP for AI agents (/mcp), published on host as 6875. Plain http, for your https reverse proxy to point at: sign-in only works through the proxy's https address, and WebDAV and MCP also need the proxy listed in KY_TRUSTED_PROXIES.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KY_APP_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace https://drive.example.com with the https address of your reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) that points at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6875. KyDrive needs https to sign in: its sign-in check only runs on an https page. It must be the exact address you open in the browser, or sign-in and uploads are refused.

variables.name: KY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first password of the admin account. Leave it empty to have one made for you: it is shown in the app's logs (CREDENTIALS) and saved as initial-admin-password in the data folder. Change it after your first sign-in.
